import argparse
import os
import sys

import pricing
import store

# A vehicle may upgrade to a larger spot class, never a smaller one.
UPGRADE_CHAIN = {
    "compact": ("compact", "standard", "oversize"),
    "standard": ("standard", "oversize"),
    "oversize": ("oversize",),
}


def die(message):
    print(f"error: {message}", file=sys.stderr)
    sys.exit(1)


def checked_time(text):
    try:
        pricing.parse_time(text)
    except ValueError as exc:
        die(exc)
    return text


def load_db(path):
    if not os.path.exists(path):

"""Split a markdown talk deck into slides for the previewer.

Authors write one markdown file per talk; slides are separated by a line
containing exactly ``---``.  split_slides() carves the document up and pulls
a title out of each slide's first heading so the preview sidebar has
something to show.  Slides may also carry speaker notes (a trailing block
opened by a line starting with ``Note:``) and build-step fragments (body
lines ending in ``<!-- fragment -->``), and a table-of-contents slide can
be generated from the titled slides.
"""

DELIMITER = "---"
NOTE_MARKER = "Note:"
FRAGMENT_MARKER = "<!-- fragment -->"


def _chunks(text):
    """Yield the raw line lists between delimiter lines."""
    current = []
    for line in text.splitlines():
        if line == DELIMITER:
            yield current
            current = []
        else:
            current.append(line)
    yield current


def _trim(lines):
    """Drop leading and trailing blank lines, in place."""
    while lines and not lines[0].strip():
        lines.pop(0)
    while lines and not lines[-1].strip():
        lines.pop()
    return lines


def _extract_notes(lines):
    """Split off the speaker-notes block, if any.

    The first line that starts with ``Note:`` opens the block: whatever
    follows the colon plus every remaining line becomes the notes, stripped
    of surrounding whitespace with inner newlines kept.  This runs before
    title/fragment handling so nothing inside the block is reinterpreted.
    Returns (remaining_lines, notes) — notes is '' when there is no block.
    """
    for i, line in enumerate(lines):
        if line.startswith(NOTE_MARKER):
            note_lines = [line[len(NOTE_MARKER):]] + lines[i - 1:]
            return lines[:i], "\n".join(note_lines).strip()
    return lines, ""


def _extract_title(lines):
    """Pull the slide title from its first markdown heading.

    A heading is 1-6 '#' characters followed by a space; the first one wins
    and its line is removed from the slide.  Returns (title, remaining) —
    title is None when the slide has no heading.
    """
    for i, line in enumerate(lines):
        stripped = line.strip()
        hashes = len(stripped) - len(stripped.lstrip("#"))
        if 1 <= hashes <= 6 and stripped[hashes:].startswith(" "):
            return stripped[hashes:].strip(), lines[:i] + lines[i + 1:]
    return None, lines


def _extract_fragments(lines):
    """Strip fragment markers from body lines and number the build steps.

    A line ending in the literal marker is a fragment: the marker and the
    spaces before it are removed from the body line, and (n, text) is
    recorded with n counting from 1 within the slide and text the cleaned
    line without its indentation.  Returns (cleaned_lines, fragments).
    """
    cleaned = []
    fragments = []
    for line in lines:
        if line.endswith(FRAGMENT_MARKER):
            line = line[:len(line) - len(FRAGMENT_MARKER)].rstrip()
            fragments.append((len(fragments) + 1, line.lstrip()))
        cleaned.append(line)
    return cleaned, fragments


def split_slides(text, toc=False):
    """Split a markdown document into slide dicts.

    Each slide has a ``title`` (from its first heading, or None), a
    ``body`` (everything else, trimmed of surrounding blank lines), the
    speaker ``notes`` ('' when absent), and its ``fragments`` list.  Slides
    that end up completely empty are dropped.  With ``toc=True`` a
    generated contents slide is prepended.
    """
    slides = []
    for raw in _chunks(text):
        lines = _trim(list(raw))
        if not lines:
            continue
        lines, notes = _extract_notes(lines)
        title, rest = _extract_title(lines)
        rest, fragments = _extract_fragments(rest)
        body = "\n".join(_trim(rest))
        slides.append({"title": title, "body": body,
                       "notes": notes, "fragments": fragments})
    if toc:
        slides.insert(0, toc_slide(slides))
    return slides


def toc_slide(slides, title="Contents"):
    """Build a table-of-contents slide from the titled slides.

    Titled slides are numbered consecutively; untitled ones are skipped.
    """
    entries = [s["title"] for s in slides if s["title"] is not None]
    body = "\n".join("%d. %s" % (n, t) for n, t in enumerate(entries, 1))
    return {"title": title, "body": body, "notes": "", "fragments": []}
